purpose: Read self-owned pending Reality, Objective and Reconciliation work from accepted current truth.

routine.return_type: TABLE(reason_code text, subject_kind text, subject_ref uuid, title text, effective_at timestamp with time zone, reconciliation_ref uuid, outcome_ref uuid, purpose_code text, session_ref uuid, session_timing_material_state_ref uuid)

state_history.current_binding: Uses accepted-current policy, Session/placement, Actual, Objective Evaluation and Reconciliation state.
state_history.chronology: Reality prompts require explicit review-on-end policy; Objective prompts require an ended bounded Session or Event placement. Date spans and floating intervals close in the person's effective IANA zone. Missing Actual is unknown.
state_history.immutability_policy: Read-only derived projection; no queue persistence or generic resolve flag.

obligations: reconciliation_open routes only to B10 Reconciliation.
realization_review requires explicit review_on_end and a bounded completed Session or Event placement.
objective_review requires an unassessed Objective after a bounded completion.
Recording the exact Session basis or an Objective result removes only the corresponding work item.
